blocks.text: Acute spinal cord injury (SCI) refers to disturbances to patients normal sensory, motor, or autonomic function resulting from trauma. Following the initial insult, up to 25% of spinal cord injuries is thought to occur not at the time of the initial trauma but later during treatment or transport. SCI management, therefore, should be multidisciplinary incorporating appropriate prehospital services, Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS) protocols, prompt neurosurgical interventions, and timely rehabilitation.
